layout.general: Left-aligned, asymmetric layouts. Generous spacing (p-6, p-8) to ensure elements do not feel cramped. A disciplined, official-yet-approachable structural hierarchy.
layout.spacing: Base 8px system. Section gaps should be 32px to 64px.
layout.surface: Solid backgrounds for school apps, avoid excessive glassmorphism. Crisp 1px borders (border-border/40), minimal soft shadows (shadow-sm) on cards to ensure clarity.

components.login_page: Split screen layout or centered card. Display motto 'BERDISIPLIN BERILMU BERAMAL' as an elegant tagline. Admin logs in with MK1993 via the standard inputs (no explicit admin tab).
components.bilingual_toggle: Pill-shaped toggle switch in header for EN/BM selection.
components.tiles: Cards with clean rectangular shapes or slight roundness (rounded-lg). Solid borders, clear left-aligned headings.
components.forms: Submission form for E-Reporting must be clean. Use Shadcn components for file upload and date pickers. Submissions use Base64 encoding for MongoDB.
components.charts: Recharts Pie chart for Admin Dashboard showing homeroom submissions by Form 1-5. Utilize official colors (variations of deep red and yellow + neutral greys) to differentiate segments.
components.icons: Lucide React only. No emojis anywhere.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach. All designs must function perfectly on small screens before scaling up.
responsive.layout: Grid stacks into a single column. Side-by-side elements reflow vertically.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling. H1 goes from text-3xl (mobile) to text-5xl (desktop).
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on main containers.
responsive.tap_targets: Buttons and links must be minimum 44x44px for touch capability.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must exceed 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2) on interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

logo.description: MRSM Kuching official logo. Place at top-right of the header.

champion_1.description: Group of students sitting in a room. Use in Champion of the Week leaderboard.

champion_2.description: Students attentively engaged in classroom setting. Use in Champion of the Week leaderboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for Mobile-First, ensuring that the 4-tile bento layout seamlessly stacks into a 1-column layout on mobile, keeping interactive elements easily tappable.
Strictly avoid emojis in the UI. Use Lucide-react for all icon needs.
Build the dashboard using standard HTML + Tailwind CSS inside React components. Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, selects, and charts (Recharts).
Implement bilingual support toggles in the header for English (EN) and Bahasa Melayu (BM).
Adhere to the 'Authority, Clarity, Truth' palette combined with MRSM's colors. Don't use purple gradients or generic edtech blue.
For Typography, strictly use Outfit for headings and DM Sans for body. Do not use Inter or Roboto.
Implement the secret admin login mechanism: when user enters 'MK1993' in the student or teacher code input, they are routed to the Admin Dashboard (bypass regular student/teacher flows).
Render the admin pie chart visualizing submission completion by Forms (1-5) using Recharts.
Ensure 'BERDISIPLIN BERILMU BERAMAL' is elegantly integrated in the login page or footer.
Use data-testid attributes extensively on forms, inputs, buttons, and distinct UI sections for testing purposes.
Ensure generous padding inside cards (p-6 or p-8) and tight tracking for large headings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs. Create depth with layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
